item.title: Fixed Dashboard Admin Cross-Browser Error - Yescast
item.description: This issue has been reported to us with regards to some browser error accessing the Dashboard Admin and we have fixed the issue already.

item.title: Fixed EverestCast Server Errors and added ec2 server on server list - Yescast
item.description: The following has been fixed: Stream URL defaults with additional numerical character upon saving on Radio Settings. Recent Tracks widget and Player Current Track no display.

item.title: Updated Brute-Force Protection - Yescast
item.description: To improve the security of websites, we have enforced a stricter protocol on our brute-force protection. Brute-force protection is used in order to prevent hackers from attempting to login into your website numerous times. Maximum login and forgot password failure attempts is now set to 4. Login lockout is set to 24hours. In other words, […]

item.title: Few updates! 2/14/21 - Yescast
item.description: We have updated some features on the website and also fixed some errors. DJ schedule is now being shown on individual DJs in the DJ section. Start of Week (Set on Settings > General) is now applied in the Schedule section. Eg. If Sunday is set, the schedule will start and displayed on that day. […]

item.title: Request form Widget Added! - Yescast
item.description: The song request form widget for Centova and Everestcast servers are now added. MediaCP doesn’t have this feature available. The widget utilizes the built-in request system of the server you are using.

item.title: EC3 Server has been added. - Yescast
item.description: We have added Everestcast (EC3) Server and fixed some errors.

item.title: Radio Theme Version 2 Enabled! - Yescast
item.description: We have released the new radio theme version with exciting new features. Introducing a new homepage with blocks. You can now have the opportunity to customize the content of your homepage using the available blocks in the Customizer. Removed the floating player and replaced with a new dedicated “Now Playing” page where your listeners can […]

item.title: Player PRO v3 update applied on all sites. - Yescast
item.description: We have updated the Player PRO settings to support the latest version 3.

item.title: Radio Player updated - Yescast
item.description: The radio player plugin has been updated to v3.0 with compatibility, enhancement and additional track album art feature. Please update the settings of the player if you are using it by just clicking the “Update” button on the Edit Player screen.

item.title: Litespeed Cache Enabled - Yescast
item.description: We have formally enabled Litespeed cache to improve response times on websites. Let us know if you found any bugs/errors. Thank you!
